endpoint_scope.conclusion: Per-logical-beam Fourier coordinates are supported as a plausible reading of the beam/surface documentation, but the public sources inspected do not prove how original ASWING assigns the coordinate and endpoint conditions to connected same-physical-index beams. A physical-index-wide series is likewise not established. No definite installed-code versus documented-equation discrepancy is proved.

inference.explanation: A finite sine series over each local domain has analytic endpoint value0, including artificial logical hinge endpoints. A global series over a serial chain need not vanish at those internal locations. They are therefore different truncated approximation spaces. Their interior sampled values remain unconstrained at full K=N when sampling is invertible; endpoint zeros alone do not prove a missing pointwise junction equation.

This is consistent with an unresolved truncated-space/near-field interaction, not a proof of endpoint causality or of a different original basis.

definitions.w_cp: V(rcp) dot ncp, actual steady control-point normal velocity

inference: Pointwise exact Eq203 gives w_cp=w_closure. For approximate pointwise roots, the difference is controlled by the local residual.

A truncated modal root only gives T r=0. It does not equate the two squared quantities locally or after nonlinear integration. Therefore replacing w_cp by w_closure changes the discrete force operator.

Large local residual can generate large nonphysical or unresolved pressure-drag contributions despite a small projected residual. That is a meaningful discretization diagnostic and prevents treating projected convergence alone as validated loads.

The explanatory statement that nonzero tangency occurs only beyond stall presumes the intended locally satisfied closure/continuum interpretation. It does not settle private ASWING implementation choices in severely underresolved Fourier calculations.

The local pressure-force scalar is nonnegative, but its wind-axis Lift projection can have either sign on a folded surface. A large positive or negative non-KJ Lift is not a unit/sign mismatch by itself.
force_definition.recommendation: Retain actual-CP Eq70 as the documented comparator. Report closure-based force only as an explicitly different diagnostic if requested, with its difference decomposed by the saved local residual. Do not silently replace the production force, fit a drag definition to archive Lift, or claim original executable behavior.
force_definition.verdict: No definite steady force implementation mismatch found. Eq70 explicitly uses actual CP normal velocity squared. Replacing that quantity by the section closure leakage is not justified as a parity correction by the public equations.

source_findings.conclusion: No mathematical discrepancy found in sine sampling B_ik=sin(k theta_mid_i), positive W_ii=Delta theta_i and T=(2/pi) B^T W versus equations63/150/201. The constant2/pi changes equation normalization, not roots.

Theta decreases pi to0 in increasing undeformed material arc length. CP/horsehoe sampling uses the theta midpoint, not the physical arc midpoint. Added attachment stations make theta widths nonuniform. Posed meshes retain these material coordinates; changing K does not change aerodynamic strips or influence geometry.

E=(B^T W B)^(-1) B^T W is implemented by weighted SVD, whereas T=(2/pi) B^T W. E and T need not equal on a nonuniform/enriched mesh. Test projection must not be substituted for coefficient encoding. The unchanged singular-value ratio gate rejects <=1e-10.

The reported Fourier residual is ||T r||_infinity with r=dimensional leakage-adjusted local residual/V_infinity. For K<N, T r=0 does not imply r=0. Equation201 unscaled residual equals (pi/2)*V_infinity*T r. A1..AK are not pointwise Gamma and no local-flow certificate follows from a small projected norm.

Project the complete local Eq203 leakage-adjusted residual. Raw CP no-penetration is intentionally nonzero in stall and is a separate diagnostic. Current code also projects the exact coefficient Jacobian T J B and the continuation regularizer. No mismatch found for the declared steady no-engine case.

At K=N, if B is invertible and W positive, both B and T are invertible and roots coincide with pointwise coordinates. This is not equality of residual norms or finite-precision conditioning. Analytic sine endpoint zeros add no constraint to interior sample values at full rank.

Current B/T blocks are per logical lifting beam. Shared physical index changes mutual vortex core treatment and does not merge coefficients or enforce sampled Gamma equality. The guide explicitly documents zero mutual cores, not a global shared-index sine basis. This is a defensible documented-surface interpretation, not proof of the unavailable original executable implementation.

All30 archived scripts request NODE I100/I40/I40 but record no circulation-mode setting or realized grid. OPER K I30 sets Newton iterations, not circulation modes. Version notes document a mode-default fix without values. Figure1.13 k1..19 is an example, not a default; its node caption/screenshot discrepancy is retained.

Production accepts projected normalized residual<=1e-8. The proposed study may require<=1e-12, but must retain rejected cases. Integrated09 terminal correction explicitly excludes Fourier modes; applying a physical-Gamma correction outside the selected span would change the declared problem. Supplied Gamma and Gamma-dot must belong to the chosen basis.
